shorts_extract.hook: Why meeting the exact same stranger on a swaying 230-foot canyon bridge quadrupled follow-up phone calls compared with a low wooden bridge.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Dutton & Aron (1974, JPSP): 50.0% phoned after crossing the 230-ft Capilano Suspension Bridge vs 12.5% on a solid 10-ft bridge—and waiting 10 minutes on a bench halved calls.
shorts_extract.twist: Your insula reads a racing heart without a return address—making leftover adrenaline amplify attraction on adventures AND amplify irritation after traffic.
